unit.why: A single tale told by the Rebbe of Neskhiz about the young Seer of Lublin, who resisted a seductive woman while travelling to R. Elimelekh; the whole scene turned out to be an illusion sent to test him.

stories.start_quote: סיפר מרן מנעסכיז ז"ל שהרבי מלובלין הלך
stories.end_quote: עומד אצל הדרך שהי' צריך ללכת בו
stories.summary_en: While the young Seer of Lublin was travelling to R. Elimelekh of Lizhensk, he lost his way in rain and cold and entered a warm, lit house in a forest where a beautiful woman tried to seduce him; he refused, saying he does only what gives his Creator pleasure, and at once the house, forest and woman vanished: it had been an illusion sent to test him.

quotes: הלך בנערותו להרה״ק רבי ר׳ אלימלך ז"ל מליזענסק
tags.why: the young Seer is on his way to R. Elimelekh's court

quotes: קבלתי עלי שלא לעשות אפילו דבר הרשות

quotes: ולא ידע מה לעשות אודות יחוד
tags.why: he worries about the prohibition on being alone with a woman

quotes: והיתה שם רק אשה אחת יפ"ת
tags.why: the seductress acts and drives the plot, even though she proves illusory

quotes: ראה שהי' הכל דמיון כדי לנסותו
tags.why: a supernatural illusion is created, though no magician is named

quotes: ולא הי' שם לא יער ולא בית ולא אשה
tags.why: a waking illusory sight of a house, a forest and a woman

quotes: מיד ראה שהי' הכל דמיון כדי לנסותו
tags.why: he realizes afterwards that the whole scene was a test
the tale is framed as told by the Neskhizer
the story illustrates the young tzaddik's holiness and self-restraint

quotes: רק מה שיגיע ממנו תענוג ונחת רוח ליוצרי
tags.why: he does every act, even a permitted one, only for the Creator's sake
